added.title: Vice President, Technology Operations
added.description:
About the Role

The organization is seeking an experienced technology operations leader with direct experience in data, data operations, hosting infrastructure, public and private cloud environments, development operations, and cybersecurity. This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the adoption and usage of advanced AI technologies across the operations organization to improve internal efficiency and accelerate product and business outcomes.
Track technology operational trends and AI advancements, identifying creative solutions to drive efficiency and greater throughput.
Provide leadership, vision, and strategy driving automation, stability, and availability of technology infrastructure leveraging cloud and on-premise technologies to support business agility.
Drive innovation across security, data privacy, data operations, development operations, and infrastructure.
Define the technology operations strategy and roadmap to support current and future business needs for scalability, capacity, and quality of service, including performance, reliability, and business continuity.
Define requirements for new technology implementations and communicate them to key business stakeholders.
Partner with senior leadership across the business to realize measurable outcomes aligned with business expectations.
Drive the execution of security, data, infrastructure, and technology operations initiatives to achieve targets for scalability, performance, and availability.
Assess and communicate risks associated with technology-related investments and purchases.
Support business growth initiatives by aligning technology operations with business strategy.
Develop business case justifications and cost-benefit analyses for technology operations spending and initiatives.
Implement the people, processes, and technologies necessary to meet customer demands.
Define, maintain, and present regular operational metrics to executive leadership, including overall security, data, and infrastructure health, risk areas, and productivity.
Define, measure, and improve technology standards across the organization to establish a technology-enabled competitive edge.
Provide technical assessments and due diligence for potential acquisitions.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, information systems, or engineering.
15 years of experience managing technology operations across development operations, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
Extensive knowledge and direct experience applying AI tools and methodologies to improve operational efficiency.
Strong technical background in environments featuring a heterogeneous mix of on-premise, hosted, and cloud hardware and software.
Experience with operational technologies for the deployment, maintenance, and monitoring of large-scale SaaS platforms.
Experience with hosting operations and leading cloud migrations involving AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Experience managing vendor relationships and negotiating contracts to optimize expense costs.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to convey technical details and strategy to non-technical leadership.
Demonstrated success leading modernization and transformation initiatives across data and infrastructure environments.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity methodologies and practices.
Demonstrated success leading large, diverse global teams and attracting and retaining talent.
Expert knowledge of technology environments, including networks, operating systems, databases, and application and web servers.
Technical experience in systems networking, databases, infrastructure, and user support.
Experience defining standardized operating procedures and services across operational disciplines.
Experience in strategic technology planning, execution, and policy development.
Experience with business processes, management, and budgeting.
Strong understanding of project management principles.
Proven experience in planning, organization, and development.
Demonstrated ability to apply technology solutions to business problems.
Experience with acquisition due diligence and integrations.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for Zone 1 (National Average) is $282,000 to $322,000 USD per year.
Compensation is determined by experience, qualifications, role requirements, and location based on a four-tier geographic zone model (Zone 1: National Average; Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions; Zone 3: High-Cost Regions; Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions).
Eligible employees have the opportunity for variable pay.
Benefits include health coverage and an employee assistance program.

Equal Opportunity and Disclosures

The hiring organization is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

For California residents, applicant personal information is processed in accordance with the California Consumer Privacy Act, and specific geographic compensation details will be provided during initial screening.

An interview intelligence platform is utilized during phone and video screenings to record and transcribe interviews to ensure consistency, reduce bias, and inform hiring decisions.

added.title: Chief Technology Officer
added.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to lead its end-to-end technology organization, spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate and platform cybersecurity.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and partnering with executive leadership, this executive provides comprehensive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer reports directly to this role.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Drive overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization's core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget and drive cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner with executive leadership to transition new products from beta to market launch while actively managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Oversee day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures while enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on (SSO), and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close alignment with organizational leadership to ensure high uptime and integration security.
Direct organization-wide information security initiatives across corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness—including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries—in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Evaluate alpha projects and proofs of concept across departments, guiding execution to integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, scalable services.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across corporate SaaS applications.
Serve as direct manager to the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), establishing shared goals and aligning product, engineering, and data strategies with enterprise infrastructure and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Build, mentor, and scale a service-oriented IT and security team aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for staff.

Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including roles such as Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or Chief Technology Officer.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise IT and information security stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, including SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Proven track record of building and leading technical teams across a broad range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through periods of organizational growth.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executive leadership, and Board members.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual salary: $220,000 to $230,000, commensurate with experience.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.
403(b) retirement plan with an employer match.
Paid vacation, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
Paid parental leave.
Professional development and education reimbursement assistance.
Monthly technology and wellness stipend.

Additional Information

Essential duties reflect the primary functions assigned to this role and may be adjusted or reassigned at any time.
Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions, absent undue hardship.
The organization maintains a zero-tolerance policy regarding abuse and inappropriate behavior.

added.description:
VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure

About the Opportunity

A national workforce development organization dedicated to connecting skilled, work-authorized professionals to career-aligned employment across the United States is seeking a VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure. The organization focuses on creating economic opportunity, scaling programmatic impact, and leveraging modern technology and artificial intelligence to drive operational efficiency and positive participant outcomes.

Role Overview

The VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure is responsible for defining and executing the organization’s technology strategy and infrastructure across internal operations and externally facing digital products. Reporting to the President and working closely with the CEO and executive leadership, this leader guides the organization toward an AI- and product-first model while upholding operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. This role operates in a full-time, remote capacity within the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Own the overarching technology strategy across staff infrastructure and external user- and partner-facing products, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and mission-aligned.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap encompassing staff infrastructure, IT operations, data systems and reporting, platform evolution, core digital products, and system integrations.
Translate organizational strategy into sequenced roadmaps with defined timelines, dependencies, resource requirements, and metrics.
Provide executive leadership with clear tradeoff analyses and recommendations on priorities based on organizational capacity and impact.
Support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning and release planning.
Partner with product leadership to guide technical architecture, build-versus-buy evaluations, platform selection, integration strategy, and delivery for participant and partner platforms.
Establish technical standards and governance for responsible AI adoption in collaboration with cross-functional committees, covering data privacy, security controls, vendor risk management, quality assurance, bias mitigation, and human oversight.
Build the technical foundation for AI readiness, focusing on data quality, system integrations, and scalable infrastructure for feature deployment and experimentation.
Oversee internal IT operations and service delivery, including help desk support, hardware lifecycle management, access controls, onboarding, offboarding, and technical troubleshooting.
Define IT service standards, manage vendor relationships and managed service provider contracts, and lead staff training initiatives to maximize adoption of organizational infrastructure and AI tools.
Oversee the customer relationship management (CRM) platform and associated systems as the operational backbone for programs, development, and reporting.
Direct enterprise data strategy in collaboration with research and evaluation leadership to maintain reliable governance, dashboards, and reporting for program improvement, funding requirements, and executive decision-making.
Implement a consistent project management framework across technology initiatives to maintain accountability, predictability, and cross-functional transparency.
Lead cybersecurity strategy, data protection controls, and operational risk management, maintaining a risk register and presenting mitigations to executive leadership and the Board.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of technology leadership experience spanning IT operations, systems leadership, and product/engineering delivery.
Proven experience building or leading technology strategy across both internal infrastructure and externally facing digital products or platforms, including demonstrated experience with artificial intelligence.
Strong program and project delivery discipline with the ability to manage competing priorities in a resource-constrained environment.
Experience with AI implementation, data governance, and enterprise systems.
Demonstrated experience partnering with product leaders on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and technical execution.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics into actionable decisions for leadership.
Demonstrated commitment to the organization's workforce development mission.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Salesforce CRM platforms.

Compensation and Benefits

Base Salary Range: $200,000 – $225,000 annually. Actual salaries vary based on factors including location, experience, and performance.
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; short-term disability and life insurance; paid parental leave; paid time off; a retirement plan with an employer match; and a remote work schedule.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The organization is committed to building an inclusive workplace where diversity is prioritized and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Role details

About Us

We are Sila, a next-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world’s transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible.

Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

Who You Are

You’re an engineering leader with the people and technical skills to bring the next generation of lithium-ion batteries to market. You’ll lead a team helping to deploy Sila’s materials in the consumer, industrial and automotive markets through qualification with cell suppliers and OEMs. You will use your experience as a technical individual contributor and as a leader of technical teams to act as a “player-coach” in the deployment of Sila anode material with customers.

You’ll guide collaboration with technical and business teams at Sila as well as external partners and customers and help the team set and reach ambitious, realistic goals by building streamlined systems, setting clear responsibilities, empowering team members, and owning the team’s and Sila’s success.

Responsibilities and Duties

Supervisory Responsibilities

Recruits, interviews, hires, and trains new staff.
Oversees the daily workflow of the team and portfolio.
Provides constructive and timely performance evaluations.
Handles discipline and termination of employees in accordance with company policy.
Assumes administrative management responsibilities for the team.
Manages employees and contractors to support sales activities with key partners and gather competitive intelligence.

Duties/Responsibilities

Drive the successful deployment of our technology with a variety of partners and work with subject matter experts to construct, communicate, direct, and execute technical goals and plans
Coach and support engineers by providing consistent feedback, guidance through challenges, and development opportunities to encourage technical and professional growth
Establish or improve upon systems for efficient and productive discussion of ideas, decision making, and information sharing
Facilitate collaboration between groups (such as Product, Business Development, and R&D) at Sila and with external partners through direct communication, information review, and coaching

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

B.S. or higher in engineering or physical science and 12+ years of industry experience (fewer for candidates with an advanced degree), or related experience
Understanding of lithium-ion batteries, components, and materials
Experience leading customer- or partner-facing relationships
Exceptional leadership and communication abilities
Demonstrated advanced engineering and project management skills
Passion for coaching and guiding coworkers through trust, openness, and dedication

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

Anticipated travel up to 25% required, both domestic and international
Wear personal protective equipment including, but not limited to, a lab coat, gloves, safety glasses, and steel toe safety shoes
Operate a computer and other office equipment, such as a laptop, copier/printer, etc in a fixed location

The starting base pay for this role is between $185,000 and $234,000 at the time of posting. The actual base pay depends on many factors, such as education, experience, and skills. Base pay is only one part of Sila’s competitive Total Rewards package that can include benefits, perks, equity, and bonuses. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Working at Sila

We believe that building a diverse team at Sila helps us amplify our individual talents. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment where good ideas are free to come from anyone. We are proud to celebrate diversity and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, national origin, or any other status protected by law.

added.title: Vice President of Engineering
added.description:
Company Description
Portfolio Management Group (PMG) is the student‑managed investment fund at Georgia State University, overseeing more than $1.6M in assets under management. PMG focuses on developing future investment professionals through hands‑on experience in equity research, security analysis, and portfolio construction using real capital. Operating under a long‑only equity mandate benchmarked to the S&P 500, PMG emphasizes disciplined research, collaboration, and long‑term investment thinking. Members receive structured training, mentorship, and practical exposure to evaluating investment opportunities, monitoring portfolio performance, and presenting investment recommendations. The organization’s mission is to equip students with technical, analytical, and professional skills, while building a strong community and network for careers in investment management and finance.
Role Description
The Vice President of Engineering is a full-time remote role responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of technology solutions that support PMG’s investment research, portfolio management, and operational workflows. This role oversees engineering teams, sets technical direction, and ensures alignment between product roadmap and organizational goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing software development projects, prioritizing and planning engineering initiatives, and partnering with product and investment stakeholders to define requirements and deliver scalable tools. The Vice President of Engineering will establish best practices in coding, testing, deployment, and documentation, and will mentor team members to foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. The role also involves monitoring system performance, ensuring data integrity and security, and evaluating new technologies that can enhance PMG’s analytical and reporting capabilities.
Qualifications

Demonstrated Engineering Management experience, including setting technical strategy, building processes, and developing high-performing engineering teams.
Strong Team Leadership skills with a track record of mentoring, performance management, and fostering inclusive, collaborative engineering cultures.
Hands-on Software Development expertise in modern languages, frameworks, and tools relevant to data, analytics, or financial applications.
Proficiency in Project Management, including planning, prioritization, risk management, and delivering complex initiatives on time and within scope.
Experience in Product Development, working closely with stakeholders to translate requirements into user-centric, scalable technical solutions.
Background in or familiarity with finance, investment management, or data-intensive domains is highly beneficial.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote environment and across multidisciplinary teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is a plus.
